register.labelZh: LOSE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: lose out on 可以幫助你表達某人未能得到某個機會、體驗或有用服務。；lose out to 可以表示另一個人、隊伍、店舖或產品較為成功。；lose yourself in something 可以描述某人非常投入,甚至沒有留意時間或身邊的事物。；這些表達讓 LOSE 可以用來描述錯失機會、競爭落敗和全神貫注。
register.summaryEn: Lose out on helps you explain that someone does not receive an opportunity, experience or useful service. Lose out to shows that another person, team, shop or product is more successful. Lose yourself in something describes becoming so interested that you stop noticing the time or things around you. These expressions allow LOSE to describe missed opportunities, unsuccessful competition and complete concentration.
